pages.title: Build a cleanroom
pages.text: Seal the walls, floor, and ceiling, then place the conditioner and precision machines inside. Supply power to the conditioner.$(br2)Its default draw is 40 SE per tick. Use Cable Coated Cleanroom Blocks for power connections through the walls.

pages.title: Improve cleanliness
pages.text: Line interior surfaces with Coated Cleanroom Blocks and move generators, furnaces, and other pollution sources outside. Wear all four pieces of the cleanroom suit to prevent contamination from your character.$(br2)Pick up loose items. Additional conditioners improve purification and the cleanliness ceiling.

pages.title: Power and recovery
pages.text: Cleanliness recovers in a sealed room when at least one linked conditioner has power. Without power, room monitoring continues but recovery stops.$(br2)One conditioner in an uncoated room gives a 75% cleanliness ceiling. Coating the surfaces raises it toward 100%.

pages.title: Troubleshooting
pages.text: Read the screen for sealing, power, room size, and pollution. Close openings and ensure adequate power.$(br2)The default scan visits up to 4,096 positions within 32 blocks of the conditioner on each axis. Keep the room within loaded chunks. Server settings can change the limits.
